scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:server && npm run setup:app
scripts.setup:server: cd server && npm install express cors dotenv @anthropic-ai/sdk
scripts.setup:app: cd app && npm install expo@latest && npx expo install react react-native react-dom react-native-web @expo/metro-runtime expo-status-bar expo-constants expo-font react-native-safe-area-context @react-native-async-storage/async-storage @expo-google-fonts/amiri
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,app -c yellow,cyan "npm run server" "npm run app"
